caption: The drawing depicts a single, neatly folded long-sleeve shirt in a pale beige color, laid out symmetrically on a plain background. The shirt features a high, banded collar with a small, detailed border. The chest area has an elaborate embroidered design in muted tones that includes two mirrored birds amid floral and leafy motifs, stretching across the front yoke from shoulder to shoulder. The sleeves are puffed and gathered at the wrist, ending in buttoned cuffs with a small, intricate embroidery matching the collar. The shirt is buttoned down the front with five visible buttons. The cuffs and bottom edges are carefully aligned, and the shirt’s overall appearance is crisp and orderly, with subtle shading and fine linework defining the contours and texture.
title: Nightgown
